sentences.en: The green lampshade casts a warm glow in the room.
sentences.zh: 绿色灯罩在房间里投下温暖的光辉。

sentences.en: We were mesmerized by the pulsating glow of the embers.
sentences.zh: 我们被余烬发出的脉动光芒迷住了。

sentences.en: You could see the glow of the fire for miles.
sentences.zh: 你可以看到几英里外火光的辉映。

senses.zh: 灼热；色彩鲜艳；兴高采烈
